items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: There was Ben and Herschel and Dick Wilson, about three or four other of the local, you know, and Hawk.

ctx.x: Yeah. Plus you could see that Ben found himself, seemed to me, like, in that.

But when you hear Ben on the records with Bennie Moten, and then you hear him with -- well, he did record with Duke once in the '30s, and then again--It wasn't until with Duke that he's really impressive--
